title: ArcadeDB 26.2.1 before 26.11.1 contains an observable response discrepancy in MCPToolUtils.resolveDatabase, which…
description: ArcadeDB versions from 26.2.1 up to but not including 26.11.1 have a vulnerability where the MCPToolUtils.resolveDatabase method reveals whether a database exists before authorization, returning different errors for 'not authorized' versus 'does not exist'. Additionally, a failed Bolt LOGON command leaves the previous principal bound after a RESET. This allows authenticated MCP users to enumerate database names they are not authorized to access by probing with certain tools.
